**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep compile test strict for required wrist modules**

Guarding compilation behind `if path.exists()` weakens this regression test by allowing missing wrist entrypoint/split modules to pass silently. The purpose of this check is to ensure all expected source files are present and syntactically valid; with the existence guard, accidental file removal or path drift is no longer caught.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Fail when legacy launcher path is absent**

Skipping when `docs/content/Wrist as Universal Joint/Universal_Joint_Model_Enhanced.py` is missing turns a compatibility regression into a passing test. This test exists to guarantee the legacy launcher still re-exports the public API; if the file is renamed, deleted, or case-mismatched in CI, users lose old import paths but the suite will now pass instead of signaling the break.
